page.layout: One printed page, a single block of text in the centre. The text is mirror-reversed, upside down, and faint: show-through from the printing on the other side of the leaf. Stains and binding tabs at the edges. No other printed blocks or margins.
page.notes: The whole page is show-through (mirrored text from the reverse side), so no text of this page can be read and nothing is transcribed. No page number, running head, catchword or signature is legible. The two dark tabs on the left edge are binding or paper marks, not print. Staining and foxing cover the leaf throughout.
